## Radiant Logistics Named One of America's Greenest Companies by Newsweek


**Recognition reflects the Company's ongoing commitment to environmental responsibility, measurable progress and transparent reporting**


Renton, Washington October 13, 2026 – **Radiant Logistics, Inc.** (NYSE American: RLGT), a leading provider of technology-enabled global transportation and value-added logistics solutions, today announced that it has been named to Newsweek's list of America's Greenest Companies 2027.


Developed by Newsweek and Plant-A Insights Group in partnership with GIST Impact, the ranking evaluated more than 6,000 companies based on environmental performance indicators including greenhouse gas emissions, water usage, waste generation and sustainability disclosure.


"This recognition reflects the dedication of our teams and the progress we've made in advancing our sustainability efforts," said Bohn Crain, Founder and CEO of Radiant Logistics. "We recognize the environmental challenges facing the global community and remain committed to reducing our impact, improving our practices and making measurable progress over time."


Radiant continues to advance its sustainability initiatives through expanded environmental reporting, emissions measurement and operational improvements. The Company has established a goal to reduce Scope 1 and Scope 2 greenhouse gas emissions by 30% by fiscal year 2027, compared to its fiscal year 2022 baseline. In fiscal year 2026, Radiant also matched 100% of electricity consumption across its company-owned operations in North America and Asia Pacific through renewable energy certificates.


As Radiant expands its global network, environmental responsibility remains an important consideration in how the Company operates and plans for the future. This approach reflects Radiant's long-term commitment to responsible operations, the supply chains it supports and the communities it serves.


For more information about America's Greenest Companies 2027, visit[Newsweek's official ranking](https://rankings.newsweek.com/americas-greenest-companies-2027) .


### About Radiant Logistics, Inc.


Radiant Logistics, Inc. ([www.radiantdelivers.com](http://www.radiantdelivers.com/) ) (NYSE American: RLGT) is a publicly traded third party logistics company providing technology-enabled global transportation and value added logistics solutions primarily to customers based in the United States and Canada. Through its comprehensive service offering, Radiant provides domestic and international freight forwarding along with truck and rail brokerage services to a diversified account base including manufacturers, distributors and retailers which it supports from an extensive network of Radiant and agent-owned offices throughout North America and other key markets around the world. Radiant's value-added logistics services include warehouse and distribution, customs brokerage, order fulfillment, inventory management and technology services.
